title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES CALLING UPON ALL INHABITANTS OF THE PHILIP- PINES AND MOBILIZING ALL GOVERNMENT AGENCIES AND INSTRUMENTALITIES FOR THE INTENSIFICATION OF THE NATIONAL FOOD PRODUCTION CAMPAIGN.

text.en:
A nation-wide campaign for the production
of foodstuffs suited to local conditions shall be further
intensified under the direction of the Secretary of Agricul-
ture and Natural Resources, who is hereby designated as
the Gereral Manager of the national food production cam-

To carry this Order into effect, the Secretary
of Agriculture and Natural Resources is hereby empow-
ered to promulgate such rules and regulations as may be
necessary to insure the success of the campaign.

The Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Re-
sources is hereby authorized to call upon such entities and
instrumentalities of the Government as may be needed
to give the necessary cooperation for the successful pros-
ecution of the campaign.
SEc. 4. There are hereby created in each province, city
and municipality, local committees to supervise the cam-
paign, composed as follows:
Provincial Committee:
Provincial Governor
Superintendent of Schools
Provincial Treasurer
District Engineer
A private citizen
Provincial Agricultural Supervisor
Executive Officer
City Committee:
City Treasurer
City Superintendent of Schools

396
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
City Engineer
A private citizen
City Agronomist
Municipal Committee:
Municipal Mayor
Principal Teacher .........
Municipal Treasurer
Municipal Agricultural Inspector
Executive Officer
Executive Officer
SeC. 5. The Secretary of the Interior, the Secretary of
Education, the Secretary of Finance, and the Secretary of
Public Works and Communications shall instruct all off-
cials under their respective departments mentioned in the
preceding section to comply with all directives which the
Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources may issue
from time to time in connection with this campaign, and
to see to it that the same are observed by all private citizens

All inhabitants and civic and religious organ-
izations of the Philippines are hereky enjoined to partic-
ipate actively in the production of fcodstuffs and to carry
out effectively the aims of the campaign. Employees of the
various entities and agencies of the National, provincial,
city and municipal governments, shal take the lead in the
campaign and set the example in their respective com-
munities in the cultivation of vacant lots and backyards
and in undertaking poultry and wiggery projects.
SeC. 7. For the effective accomplishment of the food
production campaign, the provisions of Executive Order
No. 223, dated June 14, 1949, should be given wide publicity
so that wherever vacant agricultural lands of the public
domain are available, facilities should be provided to ex-
pedite their occupation for the purposes herein set forth.

Such funds as may from time to time be provided
for by the National, provincial, city and municipal govern-
ments for undertaking the food production campaign au-
thorized in this Order shall be disbursed and duly accounted
for by the offcials concerned with the approval of the
Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources.
Done in the City of Manila, this 17th day of February,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty, and
of the Independence of the Philippires, the fourth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
